Nations Agree on Biodiversity Action, Funding Gap Remains

Countries participating in COP17 have agreed to accelerate efforts to protect biodiversity. However, the agreement highlights a persistent shortfall in funding and concrete action needed to meet conservation goals. The negotiations also saw a push to ensure women have a more significant role beyond just representation at the biodiversity table.
